title: Rotary Screen
pages: Craft the controller from sealed steel plate, two Panned Concentrate, two copper ingots, iron bars and two Aluminum Rivets (bottom corners) cold-headed by the Hydraulic Riveter from one aluminum ingot; copper ingots no longer substitute for the riveted drum seams. Wash four raw gold in a Twin Channel Washer to concentrate one Panned Concentrate. Put a hopper below the controller and a chain directly above it. Place grindstones east and west, a copper block north, a hopper south pointing north into the controller, and iron bars at all four upper diagonal corners. Material update: crafting slot 1 (row-major 3x3) now requires a aluminum ingot via forge:ingots/aluminum; all existing progression gates remain required.

Right-click the formed screen holding two complete batches of an arcana_industry:screening recipe. It loads exactly twice the listed input into the stock buffer and refuses new feed while a batch is buffered or output is waiting. After the 40-tick cycle, use an empty hand to collect both results. It will not run Crusher crushing recipes. Breaking any brace, bank, grindstone, chain or hopper stops processing.

Loaded screening recipes separate four sand into one Screened Silica, two mud into four clay balls, two gravel into flint, moss blocks into moss carpet, and rooted dirt into hanging roots. Three sand batches provide three Screened Silica: one for the Foundry Ring controller craft instead of a cauldron, one for the Leaching Vat craft and one for the Electrolyzer craft instead of a bucket. The Leaching Vat gate makes this screen and the Twin Channel Washer required t2 devices. The screen uses no FE. A hopper or pipe can feed its stock buffer through the south face behind the north-facing feed hopper; the lower hopper pulls finished items from the bottom face. It waits for two full batches, then runs one 40-tick cycle. Sneak-use an empty hand on a face to cycle input, output and disabled; empty-hand use collects buffered output. Manual right-click loading uses the same timed buffer.

Further screening batches recover dirt from coarse dirt, sand from sandstone, red sand from red sandstone, clay balls from clay, and mangrove roots from muddy mangrove roots. Each batch takes the listed input twice when operated; sandstone recovery is deliberately lossy relative to crafting.

Sift podzol for brown mushrooms, mycelium for red mushrooms, grass blocks for wheat seeds, and soul sand for nether wart. Crimson and warped nylium yield their matching fungi. These batches consume the source blocks; the screen creates no source blocks.

Break down glowstone to three dust, sea lanterns to two prismarine crystals, prismarine to two shards, and prismarine bricks to four shards. Give the controller two complete batches in one hand; the stock port also accepts recipe items from the south hopper or a compatible pipe; finished goods leave through the bottom hopper. No power or fluid is needed.
